# .4 hidden: the winner unifies Germany   .21/.22 news (everyone): the FRG / the GDR united Germany
# .30 two plus four (SOV), .31/.32 Moscow's consent / veto (DDR, GER)   .40 hidden: a freeze ends (DDR)

country_event = {
	id = totu_unity.2
	hidden = yes
	is_triggered_only = yes

	immediate = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				country_exists = DDR
				country_exists = GER
				NOT = { has_global_flag = TOTU_germany_unified }
			}
			set_global_flag = TOTU_unity_referendum_held
			DDR = { country_event = { id = totu_unity.3 } }
			GER = { country_event = { id = totu_unity.3 } }
			if = {
				limit = { has_global_flag = TOTU_unity_winner_ddr }
				DDR = { country_event = { id = totu_unity.4 days = 1 } }
			}
			else = {
				GER = { country_event = { id = totu_unity.4 days = 1 } }
			}
		}
	}
}

		text = totu_unity.3.d_ddr_dem

			has_global_flag = TOTU_unity_winner_ddr

		}
	}

	is_triggered_only = yes

	option = {
		name = totu_unity.3.a
		trigger = { OR = { AND = { tag = GER has_global_flag = TOTU_unity_winner_ger } AND = { tag = DDR has_global_flag = TOTU_unity_winner_ddr } } }
		custom_effect_tooltip = totu_unity.3.tt_win
	}
	option = {
		name = totu_unity.3.b
		trigger = { NOT = { OR = { AND = { tag = GER has_global_flag = TOTU_unity_winner_ger } AND = { tag = DDR has_global_flag = TOTU_unity_winner_ddr } } } }
		custom_effect_tooltip = totu_unity.3.tt_lose
	}
}

# The scale reached 75 %: Moscow decides (fired once by TOTU_unity_check while the GDR is a Soviet subject).
# The answer counts only while the question is open (TOTU_unity_open: no referendum called, not unified); the event
# times out to the consent before the 30-day wait (TOTU_unity_2p4_pending) runs out.
country_event = {
	id = totu_unity.30
	title = totu_unity.30.t
	desc = totu_unity.30.d
	picture = GFX_report_event_totu_unity_two_plus_four
	is_triggered_only = yes
	timeout_days = 20

	# historical: Gorbachev agrees, Bonn pays for the withdrawal and adds a credit
	option = {
		name = totu_unity.30.a
		ai_chance = { factor = 80 }
		clr_global_flag = TOTU_unity_2p4_pending
		if = {
			limit = { TOTU_unity_open = yes }
			set_global_flag = TOTU_unity_soviet_consent
			add_political_power = 50
			add_timed_idea = { idea = TOTU_unity_german_credits days = 365 }
			GER = {
				add_political_power = -50
				add_timed_idea = { idea = TOTU_unity_withdrawal_payments days = 365 }
				add_opinion_modifier = { target = SOV modifier = TOTU_unity_moscow_consent }
			}
			TOTU_unity_progress_add_5 = yes
			hidden_effect = {
				DDR = { country_event = { id = totu_unity.31 } }
				GER = { country_event = { id = totu_unity.31 } }
			}
		}
	}

	# the veto: the talks freeze for half a year, the scale falls back
	option = {
		name = totu_unity.30.b
		ai_chance = {
			factor = 20
			modifier = {
				factor = 2
				OR = {
					has_country_flag = TOTU_plenum_winner_cons
					has_country_flag = TOTU_plenum_winner_orth
				}
			}
		}
		clr_global_flag = TOTU_unity_2p4_pending
		if = {
			limit = { TOTU_unity_open = yes }
			set_global_flag = TOTU_unity_soviet_veto
			TOTU_unity_freeze_180 = yes
			TOTU_unity_progress_sub_15 = yes
			GER = { add_opinion_modifier = { target = SOV modifier = TOTU_unity_moscow_veto } }
			DDR = { add_opinion_modifier = { target = SOV modifier = TOTU_unity_moscow_veto } }
			hidden_effect = {
				DDR = { country_event = { id = totu_unity.32 } }
				GER = { country_event = { id = totu_unity.32 } }
			}
		}
	}
}
